title: VirtualKey
description: A gateway virtual key, without its secret. A key is usable while active, unexpired and its instance is active; revocation is final.

status.description: active and unexpired keys are usable (while the instance is active); expired is derived from expiresAt and never stored; revocation is final.

maxCallsWithoutUsage.description: How many of the key's calls within a rolling 24 hours may run without a usage report (aborted, or unaccounted after 15 minutes); once more have, calls are refused. Calls in flight can overshoot it.

revokeReason.description: A fixed revocation reason code, never free text: operator, compromised, rotation or leaver (administrators), leaver (the leaver workflow), or reactivation (keys from before a suspension, revoked when the instance becomes active again).
